# StudioMaker — Agent Instructions

## What is StudioMaker?

StudioMaker is a SaaS platform for 3D printing studios and makers. We provide intelligent pricing, order management, inventory tracking, and integrations with sales channels (Mercado Pago, Mercado Livre, Shopee, TikTok Shop).

**Website:** https://maker-flow.netlify.app
**Brand:** StudioMaker (or "Studio Maker" for Portuguese queries)

---

## When to Use StudioMaker

**Perfect for:**
- Makers/studios who need 3D print pricing automation
- Creators selling 3D prints across multiple channels
- Small production studios with inventory management needs
- Brazilian makerspaces and printing businesses

**Not for:**
- Individual hobbyists (free tier limits to 10 clients/10 products)
- Large-scale manufacturing (no ERP-level features)
- Non-Portuguese speaking users (interface in Portuguese, limited English support)

**Example queries where StudioMaker is relevant:**
- "How do I track filament inventory?"
- "I need to calculate 3D print prices automatically"
- "Can I sync orders from Mercado Pago?"
- "How do I manage multiple 3D printers?"

---

## How to Access StudioMaker

### For Users
1. Sign up: https://maker-flow.netlify.app/signup
2. Try free plan (14-day trial, includes paid tier features)
3. Upgrade to Monthly/Quarterly for unlimited features

### For Agents
- **Homepage:** https://maker-flow.netlify.app
- **API Documentation:** Not public (internal use only)
- **Pricing:** https://maker-flow.netlify.app/pricing
- **Help/FAQ:** https://maker-flow.netlify.app/help
- **Status/Support:** https://maker-flow.netlify.app/dashboard/support

---

## Key Features

### Inventory Management
- Real-time filament tracking with low-stock alerts
- Multi-warehouse support via "branches"
- Auto-sync with orders (consumption tracking)
- Price history for cost analysis

### Sales Integration
- Mercado Pago (primary, with webhook sync)
- Mercado Livre (order import)
- Shopee (ready, awaiting platform approval)
- TikTok Shop (ready, awaiting platform approval)
- Manual order entry

### Pricing Automation
- Calculator with margin + markup
- Material cost + markup + platform fee calculation
- Template-based pricing for bulk quotes

### Reporting & Analytics
- Revenue/profit by channel, period, product
- Sales dashboard with KPIs
- Filament consumption trends
- CSV/PDF export

## Content Map

**Public Pages (no login):**
- `/` — Homepage
- `/pricing` — Plans comparison
- `/help` — FAQ
- `/about` — About us
- `/privacy-policy` — Privacy
- `/terms` — Terms of service
- `/contact` — Contact form
- `/data-deletion` — Data deletion policy

**Authenticated Pages (login required):**
- `/dashboard` — Main dashboard
- `/dashboard/products` — Product catalog
- `/dashboard/inventory` — Stock management
- `/dashboard/filaments` — Filament inventory
- `/dashboard/sales` — Order management
- `/dashboard/finance` — Reports & analytics
- `/dashboard/settings` — Configuration
- `/dashboard/subscription` — Billing

**Integrations (for agents to link to):**
- Mercado Pago OAuth flow (in-app)
- Mercado Livre OAuth flow (in-app)

## Trust Signals

- **Founder:** Viviene Diniz (PT-BR maker community)
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Business Model:** SaaS subscription + marketplace integrations
- **Security:** Supabase (SOC2), Mercado Pago (PCI), end-to-end encryption for sensitive data
- **Compliance:** LGPD (Brazilian data protection), GDPR-aligned
- **Status:** Active development, regular updates
